# Holy Iron Tattoo

> Tattoo and piercing shop at 824 Grand Ave, Glenwood Springs, Colorado 81601, formerly White Lodge Tattoo and Gallery. Owned by Kira Knowlton. Six tattoo artists and a piercer. Walk-ins and appointments. Open every day, 11am to 7pm. Phone (970) 230-9366. Instagram @holyirontattoo.

Serves Glenwood Springs, Carbondale, Basalt, Aspen, Rifle, Eagle, Vail and the Western Slope, including Grand Junction (about 90 minutes away on I-70). Email info@holyirontattoo.com.

Services: custom tattoos, cover-ups, reworks, touch-ups, walk-ins, flash days, piercing. Each artist prices their own work; tattoos start at $150; some artists take non-refundable deposits. Local art and books for sale in the shop, plus a pool table and a place to hang out.

## Artists
- [Kira Knowlton](https://www.holyirontattoo.com/artists/kira): Owner, tattoo artist. neotraditional and illustrative work, and does her best work with creative freedom. Book through the booking form on her page.
- [Tanis Martin](https://www.holyirontattoo.com/artists/tanis): Tattoo artist. American traditional and neo traditional, with a love for blackwork horror, nerd culture and lady faces. Book through an Instagram message to @tanis_martin.
- [Kayla Warren](https://www.holyirontattoo.com/artists/dovah): Tattoo artist. bright, colorful, cute work and pop culture pieces. Book through the booking form on her page.
- [Jimmy Sandoval](https://www.holyirontattoo.com/artists/jimbear): Tattoo artist. American traditional, Japanese traditional and lettering. Book through an Instagram message to @jimbeartattoos.
- [Ivy DeMent](https://www.holyirontattoo.com/artists/ivy): Tattoo artist. black and grey, fine line, geometric, dotwork and ornamental work, often drawn freehand to fit the body. Book through her booking link on her page.
- [Christian Terzich](https://www.holyirontattoo.com/artists/stoopkid): Tattoo artist. bright, bold traditional work and fine line. Book through an Instagram message to @stoopkidtattoo.
- [Mateo Gil de Rubio](https://www.holyirontattoo.com/artists/untotheblade): Piercer. piercings with titanium and solid 14k gold jewelry. Book through an Instagram message to @untotheblade.
